content.tagline: Two Korean skincare brands, one confirmed 140-item catalogue.
content.descriptor: Two Tigers Corp (Korea): Wati for Skin micro-spicule and PDRN skincare, and Dr.Papirub PDRN-exosome care.
about: Two Tigers Corp is a Korean company behind two skincare brands, Wati for Skin and Dr.Papirub. Teranova's team met the company's sales staff at K-Beauty Expo 2026 and received the brands' official product deck directly from Two Tigers Corp.

The Wati for Skin range is built around micro-spicule and PDRN-exosome delivery formats: essences, creams, ampoules and masks across more than two dozen product families, from the signature Micro Spicule 100 essence line to eye care, lip care, hair and body care. Dr.Papirub adds a compact PDRN skincare range and one fragrance. Every product name, volume and property on this page comes from the brands' own catalogue; where the company did not state a property, it is left out rather than guessed.
facts: Two brands: Wati for Skin and Dr.Papirub (Two Tigers Corp, Korea)
140 confirmed catalogue items across both brands
Core technologies named by the company: Micro Spicule, Volufroshot and PDRN-Exosome
Met at K-Beauty Expo 2026; catalogue received directly from the company
channels: Importers and distributors of Korean skincare
Online stores specialising in Korean skincare

lines.name: Micro Spicule 100 Essence
lines.note: Twelve 30 ml essences on the brand's micro-spicule format, each built around one active — collagen, PDRN+ biome, niacinamide, vitamin, hyaluronic acid or the retinol-type RETI-A.

lines.name: Volufroshot & Micro Spicule Cream
lines.note: Fifty-millilitre creams and ampoules in the Volufroshot and Micro Spicule Cream families: glycolic acid, retinol, bakuchiol, collagen, hyaluronic acid and PDRN combinations.

lines.name: Exosome-B Ampoule
lines.note: Thirty-millilitre ampoules on an exosome-B base, paired with bakuchiol, madecassoside, tea tree, panthenol and PDRN-zinc actives.

lines.name: Eye Care
lines.note: Twelve eye creams across Exosome-B, Micro Spicule, Skin Booster and Volufroshot formats, including dedicated dark-circle concealing formulas.

lines.name: Mask Pack
lines.note: Ten sheet and ampoule mask packs (27 g x 10) in PDRN, collagen, retinol, hyaluronic acid, exosome and skin-booster formulas.

lines.name: Lip Care
lines.note: Sleeping masks, glowy balms and lip essences in PDRN, collagen and vitamin formulas, 20 ml each.

lines.name: Body, Hair & Hand Care
lines.note: Shampoo, treatment, body lotion and wash, hand and foot creams on biotin-protein, PDRN-ceramide and panthenol-ceramide formulas.

lines.name: Dr.Papirub
lines.note: A compact PDRN skincare range — lotion, eye cream, cream, cleansing foam, toner, serum and a silk ampoule — plus a woody-forest eau de parfum.

content.exportNote: Two Tigers Corp's sales team confirmed interest in listing both brands on the Teranova platform in correspondence running from 16 September to 23 November 2026, and Irina Tutova confirmed placement on 23 November 2026. This page is built from the brands' own official product deck, received directly from the company; the product names, volumes and the short properties shown on each card are the brand's own wording.
